Name: Mear's portraits for Hat Mouse Lacey
Author: AVmear
Description:
This is my take on Lacey from the amazing "Hat Mouse Lacey - NPC" mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/188952864]ichortower[/url]

Firstly let me start by saying that I'm not the greatest artist and had to resort to AI to block out the main shape of the character.
I understand this might be a problem for some but I request that people stay respectful at least in regard to the time I spent fixing, editing and making all the expressions myself.

___________________________________________________________________________________________________

For this portrait you need: 
- Hat Mouse Lacey - NPC mod by Ichortower
- Portraiture


Installation:
1.Download this mod
2.Drop "Mear's Portraits_Lacey" intro "Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits"
3.In game go to any NPC (preferably Lacey) press "M" select my portraits and then "Escape"
4.You're done, Enjoy
